## What changed

State the change in one or two plain sentences. Link the affected rule, checklist row, or file when helpful.

## Why

Explain the problem this fixes or the ambiguity it removes.

## How validated

Include command output excerpts, screenshots, rendered documentation links, or other evidence that lets reviewers verify the change.

- **Subagent-Trace:** `none` _or_ `<subagent name + brief role>`
